intent: Add one memorable moment where it costs the user nothing.
moves: Put it at a completion, not at an interruption — after the task, never before it.
Pick exactly one moment per surface, so it stays a moment.
Make the delight optional to notice: it must not delay the next action.
Write the empty state as though a person wrote it, because that is nearly free.
Let a hover or focus state do something considered rather than merely change colour.
avoid: Delight on high-frequency actions, which becomes friction by the tenth use.
Animation that blocks input while it plays.
Confetti on anything the user did not choose to do.
